name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Star photospheres paint at higher cached resolution with cellular granulation and a hard limb, so a close G-class primary reads as a crisp disk instead of a soft orange smear.
Corona and chromosphere are a tight atmospheric skin. O flares stay, just shorter and sharper. Distant background stars snap to whole pixels.
Spectral class colors, scoop zones, ships, planets, and concourse are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.4 so Pages picks up the sharper stars.
